一、长安惊变·大典
三日后，辰时初刻。
长安城万人空巷，百姓如潮水般涌向太真观方向。今日是皇帝亲临的祈福大典，据说能见到圣颜，还能得道长赐福。人们扶老携幼，脸上洋溢着节日般的喜悦，浑然不知即将面临怎样的危险。
太真观前广场，九丈祭坛巍然矗立。坛分三层：下层刻山川地理，中层刻日月星辰，上层刻满了诡异的扭曲符文——那是九幽阁的秘传魔纹。坛顶中央，立着一尊三足青铜巨鼎，鼎中黑烟袅袅，散发着令人不安的气息。
玄冥真人一身紫金道袍，手持拂尘，立于坛前。他身后站着三十六名道士，按天罡之位排列，个个面色肃穆。更远处，金吾卫甲胄鲜明，将观前广场围得水泄不通。
“吉时将至。”玄冥真人抬眼看天，嘴角勾起一丝若有若无的笑意。
辰时三刻，鼓乐齐鸣。
御驾从皇城正门缓缓驶出，明黄华盖下，玄宗皇帝端坐龙辇。他已年过五旬，但保养得宜，面如冠玉，只是眉宇间有挥之不去的倦怠——那是长期沉湎酒色留下的痕迹。身侧，虞贵妃一袭霓裳，容颜绝世，只是眼神偶尔闪过一丝异色。
御驾两侧，文武百官随行。宰相李林甫骑马在左，面白无须，眼神锐利，右相杨国忠在右，满脸横肉，目中无人。再往后，是亲王、郡王、国公……大唐的权力核心，几乎尽数到场。
唯有吴王李恪，称病未至。
御驾行至太真观前，玄宗下辇。万民跪拜，山呼万岁。声浪如潮，震得屋檐积雪簌簌落下。
玄冥真人上前行礼：“贫道玄冥，恭迎陛下。祈福大典已备，请陛下登坛，为民祈福。”
玄宗点头，正要迈步，贵妃忽然拉住他衣袖，柔声道：“三郎，妾身昨夜梦到太白金星降世，说今日大典需以真龙之须发点睛，方可佑我大唐万年。”
“真龙须发？”玄宗皱眉，“贵妃是说……”
“只需陛下拔下一根头发，放入鼎中即可。”玄冥真人接口，笑容慈祥，“此乃沟通天地，引星宿之力。”
玄宗犹豫片刻，还是伸出手拨下一根头发。
玄冥接过头发放入青铜巨鼎。
就在头发接触鼎中黑烟的刹那，异变陡生！
鼎中黑烟骤然暴涨，化作九道黑柱冲天而起！天空瞬间暗了下来，乌云如墨翻滚，遮蔽了日光。长安三百六十五处坊市，同时亮起幽蓝光芒——那是早已布下的阴煞阵启动了！

“护驾！”禁军统领厉喝，但已经晚了。
玄冥真人仰天长笑，道袍炸裂，露出里面绣满灵纹的黑袍。他手中拂尘一甩，万千银丝如毒蛇般缠向玄宗！
“妖道！”杨国忠拔剑欲挡，但银丝轻易贯穿了他的肩膀，这位权倾朝野的宰相，瞪大眼睛看着肩膀上的银丝动弹不得。
百官大乱，金吾卫与道士们厮杀在一起。但那些道士个个修为不俗，更兼阵法加持，金吾卫节节败退。
玄宗被护卫团团护住，脸色煞白：“爱妃，这是……”
贵妃嫣然一笑，容颜依旧绝美，但眼中已无半点柔情，只剩下冰冷的幽蓝：“三郎，别怕。很快，你就会成为第一位祭品。”
她抬手，指尖幽蓝火焰跳动。
而此刻，长安城外三十里，一处密林中。
杨思纯站在高处，遥望长安上空那九道冲天黑柱，脸色凝重：“开始了。”
他身后，是诛魔联盟的所有精锐——
惜若白衣如雪，秋水剑已出鞘半寸；沈轻烟挺身而立，柳如是紧握江流云的手，仙灵之力在体内奔涌；废焰老祖周身白焰吞吐；霓依血蛟真身隐现；胡嗖与小靖并肩而立，两人手牵着手，魂魄交融的状态让他们气息诡异而强大；霓影五子结成五行战阵；还有千余名联盟修士，个个神情肃穆。
江流云展开一张长安布防图：“按计划，兵分三路。”
“第一路，我、轻烟、柳如是、废焰老祖、霓依及数十名修士，潜入皇城。目标：救出皇上，揭穿贵妃真面目。”
“第二路，杨盟主、惜若副盟主、胡嗖前辈、小靖前辈，金永珍率主力强攻太真观，破坏祭坛，斩杀玄冥。”
“第三路……”他看向西方，“霓影五子，你们带剩余修士，急赴昆仑山。幽冥子此刻定在全力破阵，你们要拖住他，不用强攻，拖延时间即可。”
众人齐声：“遵命！”
江流云又补充：“还有一事——汉江总部那边，我已通知秀雅、在英、名爱、智友四位，让她们带领所有工作人员撤离到安全地点。他们四人也已赶到此处待命，此战若败，总部必遭报复，不能留下一个人。总部我已布下防御结阵。”
杨思纯点头：“考虑周全。诸位，此战关乎天下苍生，关乎我们所珍视的一切。”
他拔出水剑，剑身泛起淡金光泽——那是金水相济大成的标志：
“为了长津湖下救我的鲤鱼仙子，为了太白前辈的嘱托，为了胡嗖前辈与小靖姑娘的重逢，也为了……我们每个人的明天。”

“诛魔联盟——”
“战！”
“战！战！战！”怒吼震天。
三路人马，如离弦之箭，飞速前往各自的目标。
而他们不知道的是，在长安城某条僻静小巷里，一个穿着粗布衣裙的少女，正抱着一只胖嘟嘟的小黑猫，仰头看着天空中的黑柱。她约莫十六七岁，容貌清秀，最特别的是那双眼睛——清澈如溪水，深处却有暗流涌动。

1. Chang’an’s sudden change·ceremony
Three days later, the first quarter of the chen hour begins.
The streets of Chang'an City were deserted, and people flocked to the Taizhen Temple like a tide. Today is the blessing ceremony attended by the emperor in person. It is said that you can see the holy face and receive blessings from Taoist priests. People helped the old and the young, their faces filled with festive joy, unaware of the danger they were about to face.
In the square in front of Taizhen Temple, the Jiuzhang Altar stands majestically. The altar is divided into three layers: the lower layer is engraved with mountains and rivers, the middle layer is engraved with the sun, moon and stars, and the upper layer is engraved with strange twisted runes - the secret magic patterns of Jiuyou Pavilion. In the center of the altar, there stood a giant three-legged bronze cauldron. Black smoke curled up from the cauldron, exuding an unsettling aura.
Master Xuan Ming is wearing a purple gold Taoist robe and holding a fly whisk, standing in front of the altar. Behind him stood thirty-six Taoist priests, arranged according to the position of Tiangang, all with solemn expressions. Further away, the bright armor of King Wu Guards surrounded the square in front of the temple.
"The auspicious time is coming." Master Xuan Ming raised his eyes to look at the sky, with a faint smile on his lips.
At three o'clock in the morning, the drums and music sounded.
The royal driver slowly drove out from the main gate of the imperial city. Under the bright yellow canopy, Emperor Xuanzong sat in the dragon chariot. He was over fifty years old, but he was well-maintained and his face was like a crown jewel, except for the lingering tiredness between his brows - the traces of long-term indulgence in wine and sex. Beside her, Concubine Yu was dressed in colorful clothes, with a peerless appearance, but her eyes occasionally flashed a strange color.
On both sides of the imperial chariot, hundreds of civil and military officials accompanied him. Prime Minister Li Linfu is riding on the left, with a white, beardless face and sharp eyes. Prime Minister Yang Guozhong is on the right, with a face full of flesh and defiance. After that, the princes, princes, princes... almost all of the core power of the Tang Dynasty were present.
Only Wu Wang Li Ke claimed that the illness had not yet come.
The imperial driver arrived in front of Taizhen Temple, and Xuanzong got off the chariot. All the people kneel down and worship, and the mountains shout long live. The sound was like a tidal wave, shaking the snow from the eaves.
Master Xuan Ming stepped forward and saluted: "Xuan Ming, a poor man, welcomes Your Majesty. The blessing ceremony has been prepared. Please come to the altar and pray for the people."
Xuanzong nodded and was about to take a step when the imperial concubine suddenly grabbed his sleeve and said softly: "Sanlang, last night I dreamed that the Taibai Venus came to the world, and said that today's ceremony needs to be crowned with the beard of a real dragon, so that I can bless my great Tang Dynasty for thousands of years."
"A real dragon with beards and hair?" Xuanzong frowned, "The noble concubine said..."
"Your Majesty only needs to pluck out a hair and put it into the cauldron." Master Xuanming said with a kind smile, "This is the power to connect the heaven and the earth and guide the stars."
Xuanzong hesitated for a moment, then stretched out his hand to pluck a piece of hair.
Xuan Ming took the hair and put it into the giant bronze cauldron.
The moment the hair touched the black smoke in the cauldron, a sudden change occurred!
The black smoke in the cauldron suddenly rose and turned into nine black pillars rising into the sky! The sky darkened instantly, and dark clouds rolled in like ink, blocking the sunlight. Chang'an 365 Chufang City, at the same time, lit up with a faint blue light - that was the activation of the evil formation that had been laid out!
"Guard you!" the commander of the Imperial Guard shouted, but it was already too late.
Master Xuan Ming looked up to the sky and smiled, his Taoist robe burst open, revealing a black robe embroidered with spiritual patterns inside. He flicked the fly whisk in his hand, and thousands of silver threads wrapped around Xuanzong like poisonous snakes!
"Demon!" Yang Guozhong drew his sword and tried to block it, but the silver thread easily penetrated his shoulder. The powerful prime minister looked at the silver thread on his shoulder with wide eyes, unable to move.
The officials were in chaos, and Jin Wuwei and the Taoist priests fought together. However, those Taoist priests all had good cultivation and were blessed with formations. The Jinwu Guards were retreating steadily.
Xuanzong was surrounded by guards, his face turned pale: "My beloved concubine, this is..."
The imperial concubine smiled sweetly, her face was still beautiful, but there was no tenderness in her eyes, only the cold blue remained: "Sanlang, don't be afraid. Soon, you will become the first sacrifice."
She raised her hand, blue flames dancing on her fingertips.
At this moment, thirty miles outside Chang'an City, in a dense forest.
Yang Sichun stood on a high place, looking at the nine soaring black pillars over Chang'an, with a solemn expression on his face: "It has begun."
Behind him are all the elites of the Demon-Slaying Alliance——
CherishRuo's white clothes are as white as snow, and the Qiu Shui Sword has been half an inch out of its sheath; Shen Qingyan stands upright, Liu Rushi holds Jiang Liuyun's hand tightly, the power of the fairy spirit surges through her body; the ancestor of Feiyan is puffing out white flames; Niyi's blood dragon's true body appears ; Hu Sou and Xiao Jing stood side by side, holding hands, and the state of soul blending made their auras strange and powerful; the five Niying disciples formed a five-element battle formation; and there were more than a thousand alliance monks, all with solemn expressions.
Jiang Liuyun unfolded a Chang'an defense map: "According to the plan, the troops are divided into three groups."
"On the first route, I, Qing Yan, Liu Rushi, Ancestor Fei Yan, Ni Yi and dozens of monks sneaked into the imperial city. The goal: to rescue the emperor and reveal the true identity of the imperial concubine."
"On the second route, Alliance Leader Yang, Deputy Alliance Leader Xiruo, Senior Hu Sou, Senior Xiao Jing, and Jin Yongzhen led the main force to attack Taizhen Temple, destroy the altar, and kill Xuan Ming."
"The third route..." He looked to the west, "Niying Wuzi, you take the remaining monks and rush to Kunlun Mountain. You Mingzi is determined to break the formation with all your strength at this moment. You have to hold him back. You don't need to attack by force, just delay it."
Everyone shouted in unison: "Yes!"
Jiang Liuyun added: "One more thing - at the Hanjiang headquarters, I have informed Xiuya, Zaiying, Mingai, and Zhiyou to lead all the staff to evacuate to a safe place. The four of them have also rushed here to standby. If this battle is lost, the headquarters will be retaliated and no one can be left behind. I have set up a defensive formation at the headquarters."
Yang Sichun nodded: "Think carefully. Everyone, this battle is about all the people in the world and everything we cherish."
He pulled out the water sword, and the sword's blade glowed with a light golden luster - that was the sign of the great success of the combination of gold and water:
"For the Carp Fairy who saved me under Changjin Lake, for Senior Taibai's entrustment, for the reunion of Senior Hu Sou and Miss Xiao Jing, and for...the tomorrow of each of us."
"Demon-Slaying Alliance——"
"Fight!"
"Fight! Fight! Fight!" The roar shook the sky.
The three groups of people, like arrows from the string, quickly headed towards their respective targets.
What they didn't know was that in a secluded alley in Chang'an City, a girl wearing a coarse cloth dress was holding a chubby little black cat and looking up at the black pillar in the sky. She was about sixteen or seventeen years old, with a delicate appearance, and the most special thing was her eyes - as clear as a stream, but with an undercurrent surging in the depths.
